SELECT CAST(r.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, r.room_name AS roomName, CAST(r.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, rc.sort_no AS roomCategorySeq, r.sort_no AS roomSeq, r.lock_status AS lockStatus, r.clean_status AS cleanStatus FROM room r JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = r.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = r.camp_id AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0
AND r.poi_id IN
#{poiId}
ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC, r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC
